title: Disc cam with roller follower
summary: give the motion, get the cam, or a refusal
description: A disc cam with a translating roller follower laid out from a motion law: give the lift, the rise, dwell and return angles and the speed, and the form refuses a cam whose pressure angle or curvature cannot work and says which base circle would.
process: Wire EDM, CNC milling or profile grinding of the cam; turned and milled follower; catalogue track roller

difficulty.rationale: Piecewise formula curve with normal offset, closed-form and iterated limits as coupled ranges, seven bodies driven by a slider.

standards: R. L. Norton, cam design guidelines 6 and 7 (excerpt at designofmachinery.com, file Ch18 2nd ed. p. 551): pressure angle about 30 degrees for a translating follower, 35 with a low-friction slide; radius of curvature of the roller path above the roller radius, target above twice it
JTEKT/Koyo Needle Roller Bearings catalogue, pp. B-222 and B-226: stud-type track rollers KR and NUKR (boundary dimensions per ISO 6278)
DIN 6885-1 parallel keys: key width and hub keyway depth by shaft diameter
ISO 273 clearance holes for bolts, normal series (read from a chart labelled ISO 273)
